prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE standalone 2D game projectile sprite: CHERRY BLOSSOM SHURIKEN. The attached game atlas is STYLE reference: thick slightly wobbly BLACK outlines, very simple flat colors, friendly doodle art. Design a five-bladed throwing star whose blades form a clear FIVE-PETAL pink sakura blossom. Exactly five tapered broad blade-petals arranged evenly radially, each with a little V notch at its outer tip characteristic of cherry blossom petals and a crisp pale pink cutting bevel. Rich pink inner faces, light blush edges, small dark circular hub with pale central hole. Looks like a pink flower-shaped throwing weapon, not a botanical flower with stamens. No stem, no face, no leaves, no ornament, no sparks, no motion strokes, no text, no glow. Front-on symmetric flat sprite centered, complete silhouette and generous fully transparent margins, true alpha background. Match the atlas line weight and uncomplicated style.

Generous empty alpha-transparent margins on every side. True transparent PNG.

Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE transparent game projectile sprite: a PURPLE bumpy FOAM ROLLER. Reference image 1 is the user's exact OBJECT reference, take its hollow tube with rows of raised rounded cone massage knobs and ribbed bands. Reference image 2 is the mandatory STYLE reference: thick black wobbly doodle outline, simple flat colors matching this cute 2D game, NOT photorealistic.
One long narrow purple massage foam roller, major axis VERTICAL, length about 4 times its diameter. Rich violet body, lavender highlights, clearly visible rows of rounded conical knobs and rings; one round hollow opening at lower end with dark purple inner cavity. Use a mild three-quarter view only to show that opening, keeping body long and nearly vertical. No handle, no loaf/bread/cactus, no face, limbs, characters, text, logos, stickers or tiny labels. No detached particles or motion strokes. Complete silhouette, bold readable knobs at small size, no microtexture. Generous transparent margins, true alpha transparent background.

Its top and bottom terminate as short nearly horizontal rounded edges, the same width as the purple cylinder body. NO round ring at bottom, NO dark oval. Keep its elongated purple body, lavender highlights, rows of raised rounded cone knobs, thick black doodle outlines and simple flat style. Preserve length and size. No handle, face, letters, motion, glow or new details. One complete centered side-on cylinder with generous transparent margins, true alpha background.
